property_summary: The _BASE_RESERVE_ value remains unchanged after a call to adjustMtFeeRate.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate(uint256), the BASE_RESERVE_ stays unchanged from its value before the call.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ should equal the balance of _BASE_TOKEN_ minus _MT_FEE_BASE_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the BASE_RESERVE_ value remains unchanged when sync is not called.
After adjusting the maintenance fee rate, the base reserve does not change if no other state-modifying call is made.
Adjusting the MT fee rate does not change the base reserve.

After any sequence of public calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the base reserve equals the balance of the base token (minus mt fee base), representing that the sync function correctly updates the reserve.
After adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ equals the base token balance minus _MT_FEE_BASE_.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged.
After any sequence of public function calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the base reserve is always less than the base token balance (minus _MT_FEE_BASE_)
The _BASE_RESERVE_ state variable remains unchanged after a call to adjustMtFeeRate.
The _BASE_RESERVE_ value in the contract is invariant (does not change) after any call to adjustMtFeeRate.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_RESERVE_ should equal the base token balance minus the mt fee base (i.e., baseBalance = balanceOf(_BASE_TOKEN_) - _MT_FEE_BASE_)

The internal balance check _sync() always updates _BASE_RESERVE_ to match the actual base token balance minus mt fees, so after adjustMtFeeRate the base reserve equals the base balance minus mt fee base.

After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BASE_RESERVE_ state variable should equal the base token balance minus the accumulated mt fee base, i.e., baseBalance = _BASE_TOKEN_.balanceOf(address(this)) - _MT_FEE_BASE_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_RESERVE_ should not change.

After adjustMtFeeRate, the balance of BASE_TOKEN in the contract (minus mt fee base) minus _BASE_RESERVE_ equals the initial excess balance (before the call) - i.e., no base tokens are consumed or produced by the fee rate adjustment.

After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the actual base token balance of the contract (minus accumulated mt fee base) must equal the sum of _BASE_RESERVE_ and the excess base input (i.e., the base balance not accounted for by reserves or mt fees should remain zero).
Calling adjustMtFeeRate does not change _BASE_RESERVE_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BASE_RESERVE_ should equal the contract's base token balance minus the accumulated mt fee base.

After any sequence of calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate(uint256), the _QUOTE_RESERVE_ state variable of the reference contract remains unchanged; the mutant allows it to change due to removal of the uint112 overflow check.

After any sequence of calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate(uint256), the public getter _QUOTE_RESERVE_() returns a value that, when cast to uint112, equals itself (i.e., no overflow changed the stored value).
After adjustMtFeeRate(uint256) (which only modifies _MT_FEE_RATE_), the public getter _QUOTE_RESERVE_() remains unchanged.

After any sequence of calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the tuple (_QUOTE_RESERVE_, _QUOTE_TARGET_) satisfies that _QUOTE_RESERVE_ <= type(uint112).max and _QUOTE_TARGET_ <= type(uint112).max; the version missing the quoteReserve overflow check can have _QUOTE_RESERVE_ overflow past uint112.max.

After any sequence of calls ending with adjustMtFeeRate, the stored _QUOTE_RESERVE_ (via public getter) equals its value right before the adjustMtFeeRate call because adjustMtFeeRate only changes _MT_FEE_RATE_ and does not modify _QUOTE_RESERVE_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ remains unchanged regardless of the mtFeeRate argument.
Setting the maintainer fee rate via adjustMtFeeRate(uint256) never changes the quote reserve.

After adjustMtFeeRate, the sum of _QUOTE_RESERVE_, _MT_FEE_QUOTE_, and the quote balance of the contract (minus expected fee deposits from previous transactions) is invariant relative to the quote input.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ stays constant regardless of the mtFeeRate argument.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _QUOTE_RESERVE_ only changes if the mtFeeRate argument would cause the mtFee to be withdrawn, which is not the case.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any value, the quote reserve is updated to match the contract's quote token balance (minus mt fee), and should equal _QUOTE_RESERVE_.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve remains unchanged.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _QUOTE_RESERVE_ remains equal to the balance of quote token minus mt fee quote if base balance changed and sync is triggered.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the quote reserve is updated to match the contract's quote token balance minus mt fee quote.
After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the public getter _QUOTE_RESERVE_() returns the contract's quote token balance minus _MT_FEE_QUOTE_.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ does not change (it equals the block timestamp at the time of the call).
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ never increases more than the elapsed block time since the last call.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the value of _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ is always equal to the current block timestamp when _IS_OPEN_TWAP_ is true and reserves are non-zero, otherwise it can be anything.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ is unchanged when _IS_OPEN_TWAP_ or reserves are zero.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate that reverts due to mtFeeRate exceeding 10^18, _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ remains unchanged.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the block timestamp last updated value (_BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_) must be equal to the current block timestamp modulo 2^32.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the block timestamp last updated should be recent (within the last 1000 seconds).
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the function getMidPrice() should return a non-zero value when both reserves are non-zero.
When _IS_OPEN_TWAP_ is true and both reserves are non-zero, a call to adjustMtFeeRate should update _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ to the current block timestamp modulo 2^32.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ is always updated to the current block timestamp modulo 2^32, regardless of other conditions.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid mtFeeRate, the stored block timestamp last value changes (i.e., it is not equal to its initial value).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate with any valid mtFeeRate, the block timestamp last value stays unchanged (equal to its initial value).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, the _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ state variable is updated to the current block timestamp.
After a call to adjustMtFeeRate, the stored _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_ should be updated to the current block timestamp (block.timestamp).
Calling adjustMtFeeRate should not update _BLOCK_TIMESTAMP_LAST_.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ remains 0 if no trades occurred (i.e., if base and quote reserves are unchanged).

After calling adjustMtFeeRate, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must increase when time has elapsed and both reserves are non-zero (since twapUpdate should add the current price multiplied by timeElapsed).

After calling adjustMtFeeRate, if block timestamp has advanced and both base and quote reserves are non-zero, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must strictly increase (since the correct twapUpdate adds the current price multiplied by timeElapsed).
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, if block.timestamp has increased since the last update and both reserves are non-zero, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must be greater than zero.
After calling adjustMtFeeRate, if the TWAP is open and both reserves are non-zero, _BASE_PRICE_CUMULATIVE_LAST_ must be strictly greater than zero.
